name: structural-format-emitters-module-move
body: `solution.component.structural-format-emitters` is implemented-by `rust.structfrontend.discovery.walk`, `rust.structfrontend.lines.line_count`, `rust.structfrontend.md.parse_headings`, and `rust.structfrontend.md.build_doc`. The bundled structural scanner crate `rust.structfrontend` is lib + bin: the Module `rust.structfrontend` and `rust.structfrontend.main`/`.run`/`.tests*` and `rust.structfrontend-bin.main` are preserved, and every other unit carries a module segment in its Rust FQN. The four emitters live in the `discovery`, `lines`, and `md` modules. `solution.container.structural-scanner` is implemented-by the Module `rust.structfrontend`, and `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` is implemented-by `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.structfrontend.main`, and `rust.structfrontend.run`.
